quests.instruction: Find the waxy stick that comes in every color of the rainbow!
quests.question: Crayon
quests.hint: You press it on paper to fill a picture with color, not words.
quests.explanation: That's right! We use crayons to fill our drawings with bright colors.
quests.funFact: Crayons are made from wax, which is why they melt in hot sunshine!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the helper who gently checks if you are feeling better!
quests.question: School Nurse
quests.hint: This person often has bandages ready to help with a small scrape.
quests.explanation: That's right! We visit the school nurse for a bump, scrape, or tummy ache.
quests.funFact: A school nurse often keeps a cozy cot ready for students who need a short rest!

quests.instruction: Find the item we fill with our own writing and drawings!
quests.question: Notebook
quests.hint: It often has lines inside to help your writing stay neat.
quests.explanation: That's right! We use a notebook to practice writing and take notes.
quests.funFact: Writing in a notebook every day is a great way to practice new words!

quests.instruction: Touch the school tool we use to write letters and draw pictures!
quests.question: Pencil
quests.hint: You need to sharpen its tip so it can write again.
quests.explanation: Correct! Every student uses a pencil to practice writing every day.
quests.funFact: Long ago, people wrote with sticks and feathers before pencils were invented!

quests.instruction: Touch the container that keeps our snacks safe until lunchtime!
quests.question: Lunchbox
quests.hint: It keeps your food safe on the way to school.
quests.explanation: That's right! We open a lunchbox at lunchtime to enjoy our food.
quests.funFact: Some lunchboxes have special cool packs inside to keep food fresh and cold!

quests.instruction: Find the small pouch we zip our pencils and crayons inside!
quests.question: Pencil Case
quests.hint: It is small enough to fit right inside your backpack.
quests.explanation: That's right! We zip our writing tools safely inside a pencil case.
quests.funFact: A tidy pencil case can help you find your pencil in just one second!

quests.instruction: Point to the person who answers your questions and checks your work!
quests.question: Teacher
quests.hint: This person helps you learn new things and checks your work.
quests.explanation: Well done! A teacher guides the whole class through every lesson.
quests.funFact: A single teacher can help hundreds of students learn over many years!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the person in charge of the whole school!
quests.question: Principal
quests.hint: This person leads the whole school, not just one classroom.
quests.explanation: Well done! A principal makes sure the whole school runs smoothly.
quests.funFact: A principal often visits many classrooms in just one single school day!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the room where a caring adult answers the school phone!
quests.question: Office
quests.hint: This room often has a phone and helpers who greet everyone.
quests.explanation: That's right! We visit the office if we arrive late or need help.
quests.funFact: The school office often keeps important papers safe for every single student!

quests.instruction: Point to the item that comes in little pots of many colors!
quests.question: Paint
quests.hint: It comes in small pots or tubes of every color.
quests.explanation: Well done! Paint fills a picture with bright, wet color.
quests.funFact: Long ago, people made paint from crushed rocks, plants, and even berries!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the room where a whistle blows before a fun game begins!
quests.question: Gym
quests.hint: You might play ball games or stretch here during class.
quests.explanation: That's right! We exercise and play games together inside the gym.
quests.funFact: Many schools use their gym for both exercise class and special school events!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the place with slides and swings at school!
quests.question: Playground
quests.hint: You visit this place during recess to play with your friends.
quests.explanation: Yes! A playground is the outdoor place where we play during recess.
quests.funFact: Many playgrounds have slides, swings, and climbing bars all in one place!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the big gathering where the whole school claps together!
quests.question: School Assembly
quests.hint: You might hear announcements, songs, or a special performance during this time.
quests.explanation: Yes! A school assembly is when the whole school gathers together for news or a show.
quests.funFact: A school assembly can include songs, awards, or special guests visiting the school!

quests.instruction: Find the board at the front of class that markers wipe clean off of!
quests.question: Whiteboard
quests.hint: It hangs at the front of the classroom for everyone to see.
quests.explanation: Yes! A whiteboard is the smooth board where a teacher writes each lesson.
quests.funFact: Some whiteboards are magnetic, so little magnets can stick to them too!

quests.instruction: Touch the tool we twist open to stick our paper crafts together!
quests.question: Glue Stick
quests.hint: You twist it up like a small tube before you rub it on paper.
quests.explanation: Yes! A glue stick makes paper sticky so our crafts stay together.
quests.funFact: Glue sticks were made so children could glue paper without sticky, messy fingers!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the friendly time we sit in a circle each morning!
quests.question: Circle Time
quests.hint: Everyone sits together in a round shape for this special time.
quests.explanation: Yes! Circle time is when the whole class sits together in a circle to share.
quests.funFact: Sitting in a circle lets every student see each other's friendly faces!

quests.instruction: Touch the sticky roll we use to join paper or fix a torn page!
quests.question: Tape
quests.hint: It can fix a torn page or hold up a poster.
quests.explanation: Well done! Tape can mend a torn page or hold a poster on the wall.
quests.funFact: Sticky tape lets people join paper together without any glue mess!

quests.instruction: Touch the item we open to read words and look at pictures!
quests.question: Book
quests.hint: It can tell you a story about dragons, animals, or faraway places.
quests.explanation: Well done! A book can teach us new things or tell a fun story.
quests.funFact: The very first books were written by hand, long before printing was invented!

quests.instruction: Touch the small label that shows everyone what your name is!
quests.question: Name Tag
quests.hint: It is small, often worn on your shirt, with your name written on it.
quests.explanation: That's right! We wear a name tag so classmates can learn our names.
quests.funFact: Wearing a name tag on your first day can help you make friends faster!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the space lined with doors leading to every classroom!
quests.question: Hallway
quests.hint: You walk quietly through here to get from class to class.
quests.explanation: That's right! We walk through the hallway to get to our next class.
quests.funFact: Some school hallways are decorated with colorful student artwork on the walls!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the big yellow vehicle that takes us to school!
quests.question: School Bus
quests.hint: It is big, often yellow, and has many seats inside.
quests.explanation: Well done! A school bus has room for many students to ride together.
quests.funFact: School buses are often painted bright yellow so drivers can spot them easily!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the practice pages tucked inside your backpack for after school!
quests.question: Homework
quests.hint: It gives you extra practice on something you learned that day.
quests.explanation: That's right! We complete homework at home to practice what we learned.
quests.funFact: Doing a little homework each day can help new lessons stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the helper who finds you a good book to read!
quests.question: Librarian
quests.hint: You can ask this person to help you find a good book.
quests.explanation: Yes! A librarian takes care of the library and helps us find books.
quests.funFact: A librarian often knows hundreds of book titles and where each one belongs!

quests.instruction: Find the round object that spins and shows the whole world!
quests.question: Globe
quests.hint: It shows the whole planet, with every ocean and country.
quests.explanation: Well done! A globe shows our whole planet in a round shape.
quests.funFact: A globe is shaped like a ball because our planet Earth is round too!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the cozy time when our teacher reads us a story!
quests.question: Story Time
quests.hint: This is a cozy moment when everyone listens quietly to a story.
quests.explanation: That's right! We sit together and listen closely during story time.
quests.funFact: Listening to stories can introduce you to brand new words you've never heard before!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the quick moment we enjoy a treat between lessons!
quests.question: Snack Time
quests.hint: You might eat crackers, fruit, or a small treat during this time.
quests.explanation: Well done! Snack time gives students a quick, tasty break between lessons.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make popular, healthy choices for snack time!

quests.instruction: Point to the bottle that lives in a side pocket of your backpack!
quests.question: Water Bottle
quests.hint: It has a lid or cap that opens and closes tightly.
quests.explanation: Well done! A water bottle helps students stay cool and ready to learn.
quests.funFact: Many water bottles have a special cap so they never spill in a backpack!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for a friend who learns in your class with you!
quests.question: Classmate
quests.hint: This person sits near you and learns in the very same class.
quests.explanation: Well done! A classmate can become a great friend during the school year.
quests.funFact: Working with a classmate on a project is a great way to learn together!

quests.instruction: Find the item that comes in a big stack, ready for writing!
quests.question: Paper
quests.hint: A pencil, crayon, or marker leaves its mark right on this.
quests.explanation: That's right! We use paper for writing letters and drawing pictures.
quests.funFact: Most paper today is made from trees that are grown just for that purpose!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the peaceful time we use soft, gentle voices or none at all!
quests.question: Quiet Time
quests.hint: It is a peaceful, restful moment, often used after a busy activity.
quests.explanation: Well done! Quiet time helps students feel calm and ready to focus again.
quests.funFact: A little quiet time can help students feel calm before starting a new lesson!
